decisions.reason: The definite article in the title suggests an unsupported classification. For any constant c, cΓ solves the heat equation and obeys the same parabolic dilation law, with conserved mass c; thus conserved mass without its value does not determine Γ. The Example explicitly fixes u=Γ and mass one, and correctly proves only its properties. In particular 2Γ is not a counterexample to that unit-mass Example. Replaced only the title by 'The heat kernel is a self-similar solution with conserved unit mass', preserving all claims and the proof, and mirrored that title in the owning manifest.

reviews.reason: Checked the Example, all four verification steps, actual supplier statements and relevant arguments, the owning proof contract, and the home page. Under Countable Choice and n≥1, the normalization lemma supplies smoothness, ∂tΓ=ΔΓ, mass one, and Γ(λx,λ²t)=λ⁻ⁿΓ(x,t); replacing x by x/λ yields the later-time amplitude λ⁻ⁿ. The semigroup supplier supplies Γt*Γs=Γt+s at positive times, and the evolution definition uses this convolution kernel. The title now states existence, consistent with the contract's explicit exclusion of classification. Only the title and its manifest mirror changed; Example, proof, dependencies, and Statement/Definition interfaces are unchanged. This is a local mathematical review and repair, not an independent review of my edit.
